command_argv: set -e; printf 'ARCH='; uname -m; printf 'VENDOR='; cat /sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor; printf 'PRODUCT='; cat /sys/class/dmi/id/product_name; printf 'BOARD='; cat /sys/class/dmi/id/board_name; printf 'BIOS='; cat /sys/class/dmi/id/bios_version; printf 'CPU='; grep -m1 '^model name' /proc/cpuinfo
transport_note: First connection accepts a new SSH host key; machine identity must still be checked against DMI and CPU.
